english.title: Retailer fail to comply with requirements as to holiday brochures
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a retailer made a brochure, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BROCHURE..), available to a possible consumer which you knew or had reasonable cause to believe did not indicate in a legible, comprehensible and accurate manner the price and adequate information about the matters specified in Schedule 1 to the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992 in respect of the packages offered for sale in the brochure to the extent that those matters were relevant to the packages so offered
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5(2) and (3) of the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992.

welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau yn adwerthwr bu i chi ddarparu pamffled, sef **(..SPECIFY THE BROCHURE..), i ddarpar ddefnyddiwr a chithau'n gwybod neu ag achos rhesymol dros gredu nad oedd yn dangos mewn ffordd glir, ddealladwy na chywir y pris na digon o wybodaeth am y materion a bennir yn Atodlen 1 Rheoliadau Teithio Pecyn, Gwyliau Pecyn a Theithiau Pecyn 1992 yng nghyswllt y pecynnau a oedd yn cael eu cynnig i'w gwerthu yn y pamffled i'r graddau yr oedd y materion hynny yn berthnasol i'r pecynnau a oedd yn cael eu cynnig
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 5(2) a (3) Rheoliadau Teithio Pecyn, Gwyliau Pecyn a Theithiau Pecyn 1992.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
